title: Source-footprint constraints on a captured woman Gaussian reference and a dome capture
question: With the same compact observations, initial geometry and training budget, does relaxing the source footprint improve native color reconstruction before and after compact-only refinement?
hypothesis: A soft tether improves native held-out color relative to hard equality, while zero tether may drift; effects must be reported separately before and after identical native refinement.
claim_boundary: Development comparison of local-affine density/RGB field proxies and native 3D alpha compositing. Downloaded Haelyn is a known captured representation, not physical ground truth. No production default, CT-density, high-detail reconstruction, uncontended GPU timing, or unseen-scene generalization claim. The second dome capture was previously outcome-exposed. Haelyn maskless views have a uniform black rendered background; this does not test cluttered-background robustness. Proxy-stage models retain the fixed initial render opacity, so their appearance is a pre-native-refinement diagnostic.

stages.label: Initial geometry
stages.purpose: Identical deterministic placement per seed for all three constraint arms; Beam is a separate practical reference.

stages.label: Proxy optimization
stages.purpose: Hard equality, soft tether weight 1, and soft tether weight 0; Beam performs covariance-only repair.

stages.label: Compact native refinement
stages.purpose: The identical fixed-topology compact-only optimizer for every arm; Beam remains a practical reference with different placement/covariance repair.

comparators.label: Soft source tether
comparators.purpose: Relaxed footprint with one prospectively fixed tether weight 1. Adds five footprint coordinates per track to the same Adam optimizer and global gradient-norm clip; this capacity/optimizer coupling is inherent to the treatment.

comparators.label: Zero source tether
comparators.purpose: Same relaxed parameterization and all other restrictions, tether weight 0. Same five additional coordinates and global gradient-norm clip as soft; only the tether weight differs.

comparators.label: Beam and covariance repair
comparators.purpose: Practical reference with distinct initialization and carrier schedule; excluded from causal source-constraint claims. It also uses no embedded alpha support gating; unlike masked field placement, its initialization is alpha-free.

primary_metrics.label: Native rendered color MSE against frozen 2D teacher
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean squared RGB error over half-integer pixel centers in each frozen teacher fit window, equal-weighted per heldout view, then paired seed differences before and after native refinement. All 47 sealed native exports have full-canvas fit windows and the worker enforces this; Haelyn masked and maskless pixel denominators are identical.

primary_metrics.label: Measured reconstruction wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: Every seed retained; report medians and paired ratios per capture and mask condition.

primary_metrics.label: Process peak host memory
primary_metrics.aggregation: Every seed retained; per-process peak includes imports and teacher/cache construction.

primary_metrics.label: Source footprint mean drift
primary_metrics.aggregation: Endpoint diagnostic per seed; not an optimization selection criterion.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh CPU reconstruction worker for each dataset/arm/seed. Whole subprocess wall, driver-entry-to-saved-endpoint time, validation callback time, and process peak RSS retained separately. Offline render/conversion loop timers and report-only evaluator resources are separate; no total-startup-inclusive workflow claim and no uncontended GPU timing claim.
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median with every raw repeat retained

frozen_configuration.phase_policy: Complete and report the first dataset before the maskless repetition, then the independent dome capture. All arms/budgets/seeds are fixed in advance; no retuning after outcomes. Failure preserves its cell and is not replaced by a new seed.

converter.maskless: Fresh full-canvas fitting without alpha/mask, no support-based cropping, filtering, bounds or initialization; converter settings otherwise identical.
converter.source_encoding: JPEG quality=100, subsampling=0 for generated references; source reference and alpha retained separately in offline preparation.
converter.bounds: Camera-only axis intersection and 0.72 times median camera-center distance, same bound for masked and maskless teachers.

source_reference.native_reference_renderer: gsplat 1.5.3 classic, packed=false, full degree-2 SH
source_reference.preparation_boundary: Only offline rendering accesses 3D reference geometry; reconstruction receives camera-only bounds and fitted 2D fields, never projected source Gaussian identities, positions, covariance, depth, or SH.

frozen_configuration.checkpoint_policy: Fixed endpoints; train/validation metrics only in histories. No heldout archive opens until final model persisted. Report all seeds and no best-arm or best-checkpoint replacement.

external_evaluation.scope: Separate image-capable process after every saved endpoint in a phase; no optimizer access. Evaluator timer includes imports, reference load and previews but excludes subprocess startup; memory is separate from compact reconstruction.
external_evaluation.selection: None; heldout reference images reporting only.
external_evaluation.metric_definition: Half-integer native point rendering at the exact compact-camera resolution. Unclamped predictions for MSE/PSNR and SSIM; reference RGB follows the frozen converter resize/undistortion. Foreground uses source mask > 0.5 only in the report process, including maskless treatment. Average per-view metrics separately per condition; report every seed. Exact zero MSE has null PSNR plus perfect_match=true.

frozen_configuration.failure_policy: Abort the entire run on the first failed warmup, measured cell, external report or integrity/aggregation check; execute no later cells. Reject placement fallback, empty/nonfinite saved Gaussian states, or nonfinite retained proxy objective/time histories. Preserve the base refitter rollback policy and record accepted_steps. Preserve raw partial artifacts and write v2 failure sources, with failed status and nonzero exit code; no result is established. This task has no retry or replacement-cell path: failure closes this task id and any successor requires a new prospective protocol.
frozen_configuration.resource_clock: Driver entry after stdlib imports through saved endpoint, including Torch/config imports, protocol/source validation, inputs/cache, optimization and validation observers. Observer time separately reported. Coordinator records complete subprocess wall time through worker exit. Offline preparation timers cover render/conversion loops, not process startup or the full workflow. Validation observer subtraction removes its measured evaluation time only; model serialization remains included. Observer-excluded times are secondary diagnostics, while the primary clock remains endpoint-inclusive.

reporting_policy.top_level_metrics: Masked Haelyn soft condition median across all three seeds; per-condition tables never pool different captures or mask treatments.
reporting_policy.selection: Fixed endpoints; no winner selection. Report all paired soft-hard and free-hard seed differences before/after native refinement, all resources, all failures. Beam is descriptive only.
reporting_policy.qualification: Producer RESULT remains pending independent audit; shared v2 report plus real browser smoke required before results handoff.

live_integrity_policy.full_seal_scope: Coordinator entry/exit only; workers hash only selected train/validation archives before fit and after endpoint. Full seal checks may read heldout bytes and therefore never execute in workers before fitting.

alpha_policy.haelyn_masked_and_dome_masked: Field arms load compact-embedded lossless alpha and apply hard source-support gating during placement. No raw mask files enter reconstruction.
alpha_policy.haelyn_unmasked: No alpha loaded or used; no mask-derived bounds, crop or support gating.
alpha_policy.beam_reference: No embedded alpha loaded or used in any condition; Beam is a separate practical reference.
alpha_policy.report_only: External evaluator uses original heldout masks only for foreground metrics, including maskless conditions, after every saved endpoint for that phase.

frozen_configuration.teacher_window_policy: Require each compact teacher fit_window == (0, 0, width, height), checked before optimizer/evaluator use. Native fit_image may crop internally but restores full-canvas coordinates, and this preparation driver exports with the default full-canvas window.
